discussion.body: Liraen Quill. Female main. Origin Iunum, Valley of Songs. Design: FF8 face and fashion, travel coat over performance cloth, bow and short blade. Cannot die. Same overflow rule as Cael. Arc: court singer who keeps the party's memory when towns vanish; song-duel owner (FEAT-008). Romance: late, with Cael only, same grade as FF7/FF8. She does not narrate it. If Bengenia is wiped she is the one who still knows the isle's real names. Battle: bard-ranger, songs as timed buffs, not a full second command menu. Do not kill, do not write an explicit love scene.
